description: Turn churchit modules on or off for this church. Disabled modules are hidden from the desk.

fields.options: Unchecking a module hides its workspaces and its entry in the dock for everyone. Nothing is deleted and no permissions change, so records stay reachable by direct link for anyone who already has access. Re-check the box to bring the module back exactly as it was. The Multi-Church switch below is different: it changes what every user can see, so read its description before turning it on.

fields.description: Allow branch churches under the main church. Every record gains a Church field and users only see the records of the church their Person belongs to (parent-church users can choose to include branches). People and families are the exception: every church can look them up unless you keep them private below. Turning this on stamps the main church on every existing record and limits every existing user to it; it cannot be turned off again while branches exist.
fields.label: Enable Multi-Church

fields.description: Every church can look up every person and family by default, the way one congregation spread over several campuses expects. Only a person's own church can change them, and prayer requests, care, counseling and giving stay with each church. Tick this to hide each church's people and families from the other churches as well.
fields.label: Keep People and Families Private to Each Church

fields.description: Internal bookkeeping: the records this page hid, so re-enabling only restores what it changed.
